findings_qualitative.value: I(13CO)/I(C18O) is close to unity in all four SMGs, decreasing with LIR

evidence.quote: For all the galaxies in our observed sample (see Methods), the line ratios of I ( [13] CO)/ I (C [18] O) are close to unity

findings_qualitative.value: Kroupa IMF cannot reproduce the observed ratios; top-heavy IMF required

evidence.quote: It is not possible to reproduce the observed I ( [13] CO)/ I (C [18] O) ratio in SMGs with a Kroupa IMF

claims.hypothesis: 13CO and C18O emission is optically thin so line ratios reflect abundance ratios
claims.experiment: LTE and RADEX non-LTE modelling of line ratios and optical depths
claims.result: Unity ratio needs N_H2 >> 1e26 cm-2, orders above SMG values
claims.finding: Emission is optically thin; ratio traces 13C/18O

evidence.quote: We thus conclude that emission in both [13] CO and C [18] O is optically thin for the bulk of the molecular gas mass in these galaxies.

claims.hypothesis: The IMF in z~2-3 dusty starbursts is top-heavy
claims.experiment: Compare observed ratios to chemical evolution tracks for four IMFs
claims.finding: Top-heavy IMF operates in distant starbursts and local ULIRGs; SFRs must be reduced

evidence.quote: A canonical IMF can never produce a I ( [13] CO)/ I (C [18] O) ratio close to unity

why_this_data.value: 13CO/C18O is immune to dust effects and sensitive to the IMF

evidence.quote: is a very sensitive index of the stellar initial mass function, with its determination immune to the pernicious effects of dust.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Differential lensing, HNCO blending and high optical depth rejected as explanations for low ratios

evidence.quote: It is unlikely that differential lensing could skew the measured I ( [13] CO)/ I (C [18] O) line ratio away from the value intrinsic to the galaxy
